newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-United Energy first A$ CP due March - NAB.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-United Energy first A$ CP due March - NAB.

text.p: United Energy's first issue of commercial paper off its new A$500 million funding programme is expected to be issued in early March, programme manager National Australia Bank Ltd said.
Documentation and signing of the programme, comprising commercial paper and medium term notes, was finalised on Wednesday, NAB said.
Timing of the first issue of medium term notes under the programme would be subject to market conditions, said Ian Mattiske, NAB's General manager, Global Projest and Structured Finance.
